THE TRUST LAYER

AI can propose the entry.
Finance keeps authority.

The useful unit of accounting AI is a controlled action with evidence.

01

Understand

Read the relevant records within the user’s permitted scope.

Source: invoice + contract
02

Propose

Prepare an accounting action that a person can inspect.

State: proposed
03

Approve

An authorized person reviews the change before execution.

Authority: human approval
04

Trace

Keep the resulting record connected to the decision.

Evidence: decision ledger
A common control layer for people and agents.Permissions · Approval · Source context · Audit history
Governed proposal and commit paths exist in the reviewed source. Runtime assurance remains a separate gate.
